reflections.summary: Won because preview and piloting aligned: Farigiraf/Kingambit/Staraptor-Mega core correctly inverted Rain Swift Swim with Trick Room. Mega Staraptor over Raichu-Mega Y was correct - Contrary Close Combat vs Politoed gave +1/+1 Def/SpD to survive Swampert Ice Punch at 70% and snowball to +2/+2 to KO Politoed/Kommo-o/Swampert. Piloting secured TR (Protect T1, Trick Room T2 despite Rain) and immediately removed Politoed T3 ending Rain, so Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag Perish trap arrived T6 after TR had already gutted its Rain sweepers. Raichu was the weak 4th (OHKO'd by Wave Crash) but sac preserved 90% Kingambit for endgame.
reflections.adjustment: Expect Incineroar + Vivillon-Tundra next game to deny TR (Fake Out/Parting Shot/Intimidate + Rage Powder/Sleep Powder/Hurricane). Keep Farigiraf Protect T1 and double Politoed/Vivillon instead of passive play, keep Kingambit healthy in back, and again Mega Evolve Staraptor immediately T3 for Contrary bulk; avoid leading Raichu into Swampert Wave Crash and prioritize KOing Gengar before Perish Song stabilizes.
reflections.notebook: Opp Rain Perish Trap confirmed G1: Led Politoed Drizzle + Swampert-Mega Swift Swim Wave Crash, delayed Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag Perish Song to late game, used Kommo-o Soundproof Aura Sphere/Protect as TR answer, Hypnosis missed, benched Incineroar Intimidate Fake Out Parting Shot and Vivillon-Tundra Compound Eyes Rage Powder Sleep Powder. Our TR + Mega Staraptor Contrary validated: CC Def/SpD boosts tank Ice Punch and sweep Rain core, Kingambit Life Orb preserved. Next plan: anticipate Incineroar/Vivillon denial, protect Farigiraf T1, focus Politoed/Vivillon, repeat Staraptor-Mega evolution, deny Gengar trap early.
